basic_info.description: Set on a desirable Noe Valley flat Slow Street, this exquisite Victorian redesign by the acclaimed CHENG Design was completed in 2015. Featuring 3 stunning bedrooms, 3.5 luxurious baths, a flowing open floor plan, radiant heat, and integrated surround sound, this turnkey luxury space offers incredible amenities including a chef's kitchen with a Wolf range, Miele appliances, generous prep space, and a large eat-in island. Other highlights include a private rooftop escape with a lounge area and soaking tub, a sunlit backyard with a serene bamboo grove, and a one-car garage with interior access and custom storage upgrades.
